geo.name: HHS Region 5 (MN, WI, IL, IN, MI, OH)

series.label: RSV — % of lab tests positive (HHS Region 5)
series.note: Share of tests positive at NREVSS laboratories in HHS Region 5 (MN, WI, IL, IN, MI, OH). Weekly percent of NAAT (PCR) tests positive. Regional figure pools six states; it is not Minnesota-specific. Positivity is the share of lab tests that were positive among people who were tested — not the share of the population infected (not prevalence); it counts tests, not patients.

series.note: Share of tests positive at CDC's national respiratory virus surveillance (data.cdc.gov seuz-s2cv). Weekly percent of tests positive. CDC publishes influenza positivity on data.cdc.gov for the U.S. only (no HHS-region or state series). Positivity is the share of lab tests that were positive among people who were tested — not the share of the population infected (not prevalence); it counts tests, not patients.
